periods.time: Early summer, Ikki's ninth selection battle

name.zh: 一辉击败〈速度中毒〉兔丸恋恋

periods.summary: Ikki defeats Hagun's third-ranked Renren Tomaru despite her supersonic Mach Greed movement.
periods.cause: Both Ikki and Renren enter the match undefeated, and Renren believes Ikki cannot handle speed comparable to invisibility.
periods.process: Renren builds acceleration with Mach Greed, reaches supersonic speed, and attacks from behind with Black Bird. Ikki reads the instant she enters his sword range, slips aside, catches her collar and uses her own momentum to slam her to the ground.
periods.outcome: Renren concedes; Ikki reaches nine wins without using Ittou Shura.
periods.aftermath: Students increasingly accept Ikki as a serious Seven Stars representative candidate.
periods.significance: Shows that high speed alone cannot defeat Ikki once the attacker enters his perfected sword range.
